_doc: Upper-body humanoid: rigid torso + 2 YellowArm + fixed head camera. Every length in metres, angles in degrees.
World frame: table top at z = 0, torso centre at x = y = 0, +X forward (towards the table), +Y left, +Z up.
mount.axis_left = direction of the LEFT arm's base +Z (out of the mounting plate); the right arm mirrors it (y -> -y).
mount.roll_*_deg turns each arm about its own base axis (shifts where joint1's 16 deg dead band points).
mount.separation = distance between the two mounting-plate centres; mount.height = plate centre above the table.
Arm limits: effort from the URDF; velocity = min(URDF, real moteus setup in YellowArmSim/Jetson/ws_receiver_arm_v3.py:
velocity_limit 1.0 motor rev/s / reduction 10.76 (j1), 8.14 (j2-j5, differential pairs), 4.1 (j6-j7)).
The YellowArm USD ships with looser drives (j1 200 Nm, j2-j3 100 Nm); the humanoid sim overrides them with these.
'selected' is filled by humanoid_reach_probe.py --write-selected ONLY after the user approves a configuration.

torso._note: lateral: torso width = separation (plates on its sides). Other mounts hang from a shoulder bar and the torso narrows to separation - 2 * shoulder_clearance (link1 housing half-width 0.093 + 0.022), between min_width and width

head_camera._note: pitch is chosen per configuration so the shared workspace is centred; fov is horizontal = vertical (square image)

down._desc: arm hangs straight down from a shoulder bar

lateral._desc: arm sticks out sideways from the torso side (as the YellowArm USD is mounted)
